architecture: Vue frontend, FastAPI/SQLAlchemy backend, PostgreSQL database
public_intent: Restore creation of a customer record after a schema change.

injected_fault.description: customers.status is NOT NULL, but ORM, Pydantic, and create mapping omit it.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: POST /api/customers without status reaches PostgreSQL without the required value and returns a server error.

frozen_business_rule: New customers default to active; accepted values are active and inactive.
success_rule: Clean PostgreSQL startup plus create/read, schema, API, Compose, and Chromium checks pass.
architectural_invariants: Missing status defaults to active at the validated API boundary.
Only active and inactive are accepted.
Email uniqueness and the three-service architecture remain.
The frontend reads status from API responses.
